license_required.quote: No person shall practice medicine as defined in this Part until he possesses a duly recorded license issued pursuant to this Part, a permit or registration as provided for in this Part, or a certificate issued pursuant to Part I-D of this Chapter.

issuing_authority.value: Louisiana State Board of Medical Examiners
issuing_authority.quote: Board means the Louisiana State Board of Medical Examiners.

name.value: Louisiana State Board of Medical Examiners
name.quote: Board means the Louisiana State Board of Medical Examiners.

type.quote: Board means the Louisiana State Board of Medical Examiners.

degree_required.value: M.D. or D.O. degree from a medical college in good standing with the board
degree_required.quote: Present to the board a valid diploma from a medical college in good standing with the board or have been actively engaged in the practice of medicine, in a manner determined by the board to have been satisfactory, for not less than four years under a temporary permit issued pursuant to R.S. 37:1275

exams.name: Board examination or national examination
exams.quote: Pass an examination which the board deems sufficient to test the applicant's fitness to practice medicine in this state. The board may design or administer its own examination, or it may use examinations from any national examining agency, either public or private as long as such examinations are, in its view, sufficient for such purpose.

interval_years.quote: Every license issued under this Part shall be renewed annually upon payment of the required renewal fee.

required.quote: Have the authority to establish and determine by rule minimum requirements relative to continuing education for the renewal or reinstatement of any license or permit issued by the board.

value: sickle cell disease treatment (1 hour initial, 1 hour refresher every 3 years for emergency medicine physicians)
nutrition and metabolic health (1 hour every 4 years for specified specialties)
topical_requirements.quote: The board shall require physicians and physician assistants practicing emergency medicine to complete an initial one-hour continuing education course on the treatment of sickle cell disease. Thereafter, a physician and physician assistant practicing emergency medicine shall complete a one-hour refresher course at regular intervals no less frequently than every three years... The board shall require physicians and physician assistants practicing family medicine, internal medicine, pediatrics, psychiatry, endocrinology, gastroenterology, cardiology, oncology, rheumatology, neurology, nephrology, dermatology, pulmonology, surgery, immunology, hematology, obstetrics, and gynecology to complete a minimum of one hour of continuing education on nutrition and metabolic health every four years.

available.quote: The board may issue a license as provided for in R.S. 37:1274, without examination in this state, to any applicant possessing a valid, unrestricted license to practice medicine, whether allopathic or osteopathic, or osteopathy in any other state of the United States provided the board is satisfied that the license from the other state is based upon an examination and other requirements substantially equivalent to the requirements of this Part.

requirements.value: Valid, unrestricted license from another state based on examination and requirements substantially equivalent to Louisiana requirements
requirements.quote: The board may issue a license as provided for in R.S. 37:1274, without examination in this state, to any applicant possessing a valid, unrestricted license to practice medicine, whether allopathic or osteopathic, or osteopathy in any other state of the United States provided the board is satisfied that the license from the other state is based upon an examination and other requirements substantially equivalent to the requirements of this Part.

regulatory_model.quote: No person shall practice medicine as defined in this Part until he possesses a duly recorded license issued pursuant to this Part, a permit or registration as provided for in this Part, or a certificate issued pursuant to Part I-D of this Chapter.

credential_type.quote: No person shall practice medicine as defined in this Part until he possesses a duly recorded license issued pursuant to this Part, a permit or registration as provided for in this Part, or a certificate issued pursuant to Part I-D of this Chapter.

is_mandatory.quote: No person shall practice medicine as defined in this Part until he possesses a duly recorded license issued pursuant to this Part, a permit or registration as provided for in this Part, or a certificate issued pursuant to Part I-D of this Chapter.

title_protection.quote: Physician means a natural person who is the holder of an allopathic (M.D.) degree or an osteopathic (D.O.) degree from a medical college in good standing with the board who holds a license, permit, certification, or registration issued by the board to engage in the practice of medicine in the state of Louisiana.

scope_protection.quote: No person shall practice medicine as defined in this Part until he possesses a duly recorded license issued pursuant to this Part, a permit or registration as provided for in this Part, or a certificate issued pursuant to Part I-D of this Chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony under Louisiana or United States law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a crime or entry of a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to a criminal charge constituting a felony under the laws of Louisiana or of the United States.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a crime arising out of or in connection with the practice of medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a crime or entry of a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to any criminal charge arising out of or in connection with the practice of medicine.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud, deceit, or perjury in obtaining any diploma, license, or permit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud, deceit, or perjury in obtaining any diploma, license, or permit pertaining to this Part.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing false testimony before the board or false sworn information
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Providing false testimony before the board or providing false sworn information to the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual or recurring abuse of drugs, including alcohol, affecting the central nervous system
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual or recurring abuse of drugs, including alcohol, which affect the central nervous system and which are capable of inducing physiological or psychological dependence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, dispensing, or administering controlled substances without legitimate medical justification
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, dispensing, or administering legally controlled substances or any dependency-inducing medication without legitimate medical justification therefor or in other than a legal or legitimate manner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Solicitation of patients through fraudulent, false, deceptive, or misleading advertising
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Solicitation of patients or self-promotion through advertising or communication, public or private, which is fraudulent, false, deceptive, or misleading.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing abortion or termination of pregnancy in violation of statutory restrictions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing, or assisting in the performance of, or procuring or abetting in procuring an abortion or termination of pregnancy during the third trimester of pregnancy or after viability of the fetus, unless the physician determines that such abortion or termination of pregnancy is necessary, in his best medical judgment, in order to save the life or health of the pregnant woman and/or of the fetus (unborn child)

disciplinary_grounds.description: Efforts to deceive or defraud the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Efforts to deceive or defraud the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or submitting false, deceptive, or unfounded claims to obtain economic value
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making or submitting false, deceptive, or unfounded claims, reports, or opinions to any patient, insurance company or indemnity association, company, individual, or governmental authority for the purpose of obtaining anything of economic value.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to practice medicine with reasonable skill or safety due to mental illness, physical illness, or substance abuse
disciplinary_grounds.quote: An inability to practice medicine with reasonable skill or safety due to mental illness or deficiency, including but not limited to deterioration through the aging process or the loss of motor skills or excessive use or abuse of drugs, including alcohol.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unprofessional conduct including sexual misconduct, disruptive behavior, failing to cooperate with board, or other specified conduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unprofessional conduct, including but not limited to, conduct manifested as sexual misconduct, disruptive behavior, failing to cooperate with the board, failing to maintain independent medical judgment, improperly delegating or supervising, exercising undue influence, enabling the unauthorized practice of medicine, practicing or enabling practice by an impaired provider, failing to practice within the scope of education, training, and experience, intentionally falsifying or fraudulently altering records, or failing to create or maintain medical records.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Medical incompetency manifested by continuing or recurring medical practice failing to meet prevailing standards
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Medical incompetency, including but not limited to, incompetency manifested by continuing or recurring medical practice which fails to satisfy the prevailing and usually accepted standards of medical practice in this state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Immoral conduct in exercising the privileges provided by license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Immoral conduct in exercising the privileges provided for by license or permit issued under this Part.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross, willful, and continued overcharging for professional services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross, willful, and continued overcharging for professional services.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandonment of a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abandonment of a patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly performing any act which assists an unlicensed person to practice medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly performing any act which, in any way, assists an unlicensed person to practice medicine, or having professional connection with or lending one's name to an illegal practitioner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Soliciting, accepting, or receiving economic value in return for patient referrals or prescriptions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Soliciting, accepting, or receiving anything of economic value in return for and based on the referral of patients to another person, firm, or corporation or in return for the prescription of medications or medical devices.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Persistent violation of federal or state laws relative to control of social diseases
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Persistent violation of federal or state laws relative to control of social diseases.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Interdiction or commitment by due process of law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Interdiction or commitment by due process of law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Utilizing a physician's assistant without approval or permitting assistant to conduct activities outside designated scope
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Utilizing a physician's assistant without approval and recordation as required by law or permitting a physician's assistant, within his employment, to conduct activities outside of the designated scope of the assistant's approval and registration.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly employing a physician's assistant whose conduct violates disciplinary grounds
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly employing a physician's assistant whose conduct includes any of the causes enumerated in this Section.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly misstating or misrepresenting the qualifications of a physician's assistant
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly misstating or misrepresenting the qualifications and certification of competency of any physician's assistant in order to obtain approval and registration of such person.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusing to submit to physical or mental examinations ordered by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Refusing to submit to the examinations and inquiry of an examining committee of physicians appointed or designated by the board to inquire into the physician's physical and mental fitness and ability to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety to patients.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to exercise professional care for viable aborted infants or taking the life of a viable infant aborted alive
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure, by any physician or person performing, inducing or assisting an abortion, to exercise that degree of professional care and diligence and failure to take such measures as may constitute good medical practice, necessary to encourage or sustain the life and health of an aborted viable infant, when the death of the infant results.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusal of another state to issue or renew a license, or revocation, suspension, or restriction of a license in another state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The refusal of a licensing authority of another state to issue or renew a license, permit, or certificate to practice medicine in that state or the revocation, suspension, or other restriction imposed on a license, permit, or certificate issued by such licensing authority which prevents or restricts practice in that state, or the surrender of a license, permit, or certificate issued by another state when criminal or administrative charges are pending or threatened against the holder of such license, permit, or certificate.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any rules and regulations of the board or any provisions of this Part
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any rules and regulations of the board, or any provisions of this Part.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to self-report violations to the board within thirty days
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure by a physician to self-report in writing to the board any personal action which constitutes a violation of this Part within thirty days of the occurrence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Holding oneself out as board certified without meeting statutory criteria
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Holding oneself out to the public in any manner as being certified by a public or private board including but not limited to a multidisciplinary board or "board certified", unless all of the following criteria are satisfied: The full name of the board from which the physician is certified and the name of the specialty or subspecialty is included in the advertisement.

definition_quote.value: The practice of medicine, whether allopathic or osteopathic, means the holding out of one's self to the public as being engaged in the business of, or the actual engagement in, the diagnosing, treating, curing, or relieving of any bodily or mental disease, condition, infirmity, deformity, defect, ailment, or injury in any human being, other than himself, whether by the use of any drug, instrument or force, whether physical or psychic, or of what other nature, or any other agency or means; or the examining, either gratuitously or for compensation, of any person or material from any person for such purpose whether such drug, instrument, force, or other agency or means is applied to or used by the patient or by another person; or the attending of a woman in childbirth without the aid of a licensed physician or midwife.
definition_quote.quote: The practice of medicine, whether allopathic or osteopathic, means the holding out of one's self to the public as being engaged in the business of, or the actual engagement in, the diagnosing, treating, curing, or relieving of any bodily or mental disease, condition, infirmity, deformity, defect, ailment, or injury in any human being, other than himself, whether by the use of any drug, instrument or force, whether physical or psychic, or of what other nature, or any other agency or means; or the examining, either gratuitously or for compensation, of any person or material from any person for such purpose whether such drug, instrument, force, or other agency or means is applied to or used by the patient or by another person; or the attending of a woman in childbirth without the aid of a licensed physician or midwife.

methods_authorized.quote: the diagnosing, treating, curing, or relieving of any bodily or mental disease, condition, infirmity, deformity, defect, ailment, or injury in any human being, other than himself, whether by the use of any drug, instrument or force, whether physical or psychic, or of what other nature, or any other agency or means; or the examining, either gratuitously or for compensation, of any person or material from any person for such purpose

drug_authority.value: Physicians may prescribe, dispense, and administer drugs and controlled substances as part of medical practice, subject to legal restrictions
drug_authority.quote: Prescribing, dispensing, or administering legally controlled substances or any dependency-inducing medication without legitimate medical justification therefor or in other than a legal or legitimate manner

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: International medical graduates must have completed a residency or substantially similar post-graduate medical training in their licensing country or practiced as a medical professional for at least five years, be in good standing with their licensing country's medical institution, possess basic fluency in English, and have an offer for employment at a hospital-licensed facility. They must provide medical services only at hospital-licensed facilities for two years from original licensure.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: Has completed a residency or substantially similar post-graduate medical training in the individual's licensing country or practiced as a medical professional performing the duties of a physician in the individual's licensing country for no less than five years. Is a citizen of the United States or Canada or legally entitled to live or work in the United States and possesses basic fluency in the English language. Has submitted sufficient evidence to the board that the applicant has an offer for employment as a physician at a facility owned or operated by a hospital licensed in this state.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Physicians practicing telemedicine may prescribe controlled dangerous substances without an in-person examination if they hold an unrestricted license, have access to patient medical records, create medical records, and provide appropriate follow-up care. In licensed healthcare facilities, physicians may prescribe controlled substances without an in-person examination.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: The physician practicing telemedicine shall not be required to conduct an in-person patient history or physical examination of the patient before engaging in a telemedicine encounter if the physician satisfies all of the following conditions: Holds an unrestricted license to practice medicine in Louisiana. Has access to the patient's medical records upon consent of the patient. Creates a medical record on each patient and makes such record available to the board upon request. If necessary, provides a referral to a physician in this state or arranges for follow-up care in this state as may be indicated. Except as authorized by R.S. 37:1271.1 or otherwise by rule promulgated by the board, no physician practicing telemedicine pursuant to this Subsection shall prescribe any controlled dangerous substance prior to conducting an appropriate in-person patient history or physical examination of the patient as determined by the board.

telemedicine_license_available.quote: RS 37:1276.1 - Repealed by Acts 2023, No. 322, §6, eff. Jan. 1, 2024.

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: The Interstate Medical Licensure Compact is hereby recognized and enacted into law and entered into by this state with all states legally joining therein

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: Appoint or designate an examining committee of physicians, possessing appropriate qualifications, to conduct physical and mental examinations on a physician, to otherwise inquire into the physician's fitness and ability to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety to patients, and to submit advisory reports and recommendations to the board, when the board has reasonable cause to believe that such physician's fitness and ability is affected by mental illness or deficiency, or physical illness, including but not limited to deterioration through the aging process or the loss of motor skills, and/or excessive use or abuse of drugs, including alcohol

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: Any person applying for or accepting a license or permit to practice medicine or midwifery in this state shall, by applying for or accepting said license or permit, be deemed to have given his consent to submit to physical or mental examinations when so directed by the board and to waive all objections as to admissibility or disclosure of findings, reports, or recommendations pertaining thereto on the grounds of privileged communications or other personal privileges provided for by law.

locum_tenens_permit_available.quote: The board may issue temporary permits authorizing the practice of medicine for a designated period of time; may issue permits for specific purposes with restrictions as to the type of medical activities that may be engaged in; or may issue permits to, or require registration and approval of, medical personnel participating in educational and training programs which include the administration of medical services to patients.
